findings.evidence: mathlib TensorProduct.map_id at LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/Map.lean:136 and map_comp at :110; `change` at lines 417 and 453 carry no justifying comment (rubric: change/show are a code smell unless documented).
findings.fix: Prove the underlying linear-map identity with TensorProduct.map_id / TensorProduct.map_comp (via the tensor_toLinearMap simp lemma) and lift through Hom.ext; this removes the induction and the undocumented `change`.
findings.issue: tensor_id_aux (line 417) and tensor_comp_aux (line 453) use an undocumented `change` into `.toLinearMap` form and then re-derive additivity through `map_add` and TensorProduct.induction_on, reinventing existing lemmas.

findings.evidence: Lines 253-254 vs sibling `simp [hy₁, hy₂, TensorProduct.tmul_add]` at 234/278 and `simp [hx₁, hx₂, TensorProduct.add_tmul]` at 255 (rubric: prefer robust automation over long named-lemma rw chains).
findings.fix: Replace with `simp [hy₁, hy₂, TensorProduct.tmul_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul]`; if automation genuinely fails, add a comment stating why the manual chain is required.
findings.issue: tensorCoact_rTensor_tensorCombine_core closes its tmul/add case with a 9-step `rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul, ...]` chain, while the zero/tmul-tmul/other add cases in the same proof use `simp`; nothing explains why simp is avoided here.

summary: The coassociativity/counit helpers are factored reasonably, but the morphism-tensor proofs reinvent Mathlib's TensorProduct.map_id/map_comp via undocumented `change` plus manual induction, and one core helper keeps a brittle multi-lemma rw chain where sibling cases use simp.
